stances_toward.note: Russia is still Armenia's treaty ally on paper (CSTO membership, which the dataset turns into an 'ally' floor; the 1997 friendship treaty; the 102nd base in Gyumri, lease to 2044) and its largest trading partner (35.5% of foreign trade), gas monopolist and remittance source. In structure it is no longer an alliance: the CSTO has been frozen since February 2024, Pashinyan says Armenia will not return in the next five years and that he would be 'very pleased' to be expelled, Russian border guards left Zvartnots on 31 Jul 2024, Russia's share of arms procurement fell from over 96% to about 10%, Pashinyan says 'we are not Russia's allies on Ukraine' and that the Gyumri base 'adds nothing', and Moscow answers with import bans (spring 2026), a notified threat to denounce the gas agreement (27 May 2026) and Medvedev's 'second Ukraine' (Oct 2026). Carnegie reports Putin now deals with Pashinyan 'as a partner, albeit a problematic one, not as an ally'. Hence 'partner' (transactional, unaligned) rather than 'reluctant_ally' or 'rival'. Bond - grievance: the lasting wound is Russia's non-intervention in 2021-23 and the Karabakh loss, laid on top of deep economic and human ties (a large diaspora and workers in Russia). Armenia is not Russia's mortal enemy and Russia is not Armenia's.

Bond - kin: shared language, Soviet history and a common-state project; Minsk presents it as brotherhood.

stances_toward.note: Moldova's 2023 national security strategy names Russia the main threat (Jamestown's headline calls it an 'existential threat') and says Russian troops are 'illegally stationed'; Sandu told the nation in Sep 2025 that the Kremlin was spending hundreds of millions of euros on a plan for unrest and 'a springboard to Odesa'; on 11 Aug 2026 Chișinău recalled its ambassador over the Crocmaz drone. But the ontology reserves 'adversary' for a mortal enemy whose declared aim is the other's defeat or disappearance. Moldova's aim is withdrawal of the Russian garrison and a stop to interference, not Russia's defeat; embassies remain open and Russia's own embassy (11 Aug 2026) says it is open to dialogue; Russia's aim in Chișinău is a compliant government, not the abolition of the state. The structure is the hardest rival, not an adversary. No source uses the word 'rival': the grade is our reading (confidence C). Bond - grievance: 1992 war, a 30-year occupation, subversion.
